notice: Preview version · Illustrative items and prices · Every order is confirmed by the bookshop.

hero.title: A page opens.
hero.intro: Books, school supplies and office stationery. Fill your basket in a few clicks for home delivery in Yaoundé, with payment on delivery.

strip.title: How it works
strip.step1Text: A simple catalogue for school and office.
strip.step2Text: Neighbourhood, landmark and preferred time slot.
strip.step3Text: Cash, Orange Money or MTN MoMo, once activated.

catalogue.title: It all starts here.
catalogue.searchPlaceholder: Search for a notebook, a pen…

lists.title: A school list? We'll handle the rest.
lists.text: Gather the books and supplies requested by the school. Prepare your quote request with the class, references and quantities.
lists.editionTitle: The right item, the right edition.
lists.editionText: Each book must be confirmed by its title, author and edition. Any substitution requires your approval.
lists.businessText: Paper, binders, pens and supplies: list your recurring needs in your quote request.
lists.whatsapp: Send your list directly via WhatsApp from the quote form.

delivery.title: Delivery, made clear.
delivery.step1Text: Give your neighbourhood and a precise landmark. Delivery areas will be confirmed by the bookshop.
delivery.step2Text: Fees depend on your neighbourhood (table below). Availability and lead time are confirmed before dispatch.
delivery.step3Text: Check your parcel, then pay on delivery. No online payment is requested in this version.

footer.address: Carrefour Abbia, opposite the Manège, Yaoundé, Cameroon

cart.title: Your basket
cart.empty: Your basket is empty. Browse our selection.
cart.fees: Delivery: {{min}} to {{max}} depending on the neighbourhood.
cart.minimum: Add {{missing}} more to reach the minimum order ({{min}}).

form.intro: Your summary is prepared here. It is only sent to the bookshop if you click "Send via WhatsApp".
form.name: Recipient's name
form.consent: I understand that prices, stock and delivery time must be confirmed by the bookshop.
form.slotHelp: To be confirmed by the bookshop.
form.paymentHelp: Orange Money and MTN MoMo subject to activation.

result.title: Your summary is ready
result.text: Send it to the bookshop via WhatsApp: your order will be confirmed by message or phone.
result.afterSend: Has your message been sent on WhatsApp? Empty your basket so you don't send the same order again by mistake.

terms.title: About this version
terms.p1: This site is a private preview of the upcoming service of the Librairie Papeterie du Centre. Products, prices and visuals are illustrative.
terms.p2: Your basket is stored only in your browser. The form information is used to create your summary.
terms.p3: Before commercial launch: complete the legal notice, add real prices and stock, validate the delivery table.

admin.title: Manage items
admin.intro: Changes are saved on the server and show up straight away in the site's catalogue.
admin.loading: Loading… (up to a minute if the server was asleep)
admin.confirmText: The item is permanently deleted from the API. To only take it off sale, untick “Available” instead.
admin.fLabelHelp: 2 lines max, separated by “/” (e.g. NOTEBOOK / 200 PAGES)
admin.fImageHelp: Local path, e.g. img/produits/notebook.webp (file in public/img/produits/)
admin.errImage: Local path starting with img/ (.webp, .avif, .png, .jpg or .svg photo).
admin.errEn: Fill in both the English name and description, or neither.
admin.usersIntro: An administrator can manage items and accounts. The last administrator cannot be demoted.
